label: Deal 6 each
hint: Six cards, face up, onto each player's place on the table.
announce: {name} dealt six cards to each player.

label: Record hands
hint: Keep a record of every hand and who has not traded yet. Trading carries on.

label: Reset
hint: Put the table back as it was when the activity began: the 18 cards of the base deck, shuffled.
confirm: Are you sure? This takes every card off the activity's table and lays it out again, as it was when the activity began.

label: Collect all cards
hint: Every card back into the deck, face down, shuffled.
announce: {name} collected every card into the deck.
